title: Implement Pi fresh-worker spawn bridge
summary: Let daemon/runtime request fresh Pi worker or validator sessions through command-context APIs with exact platform/content blockers and dirty-content proof handoff policy.

goal.outcome: Daemon/runtime can spawn or queue fresh worker/validator sessions from CodeWiki source refs when Pi command-context APIs are available, and block safely with exact reasons when unavailable.
acceptance: Runtime exposes a fresh-worker request/handoff contract with role, task/build refs, trace_refs, gate_refs, git_refs, and content proof requirements.
Pi adapter bridge uses command-context `ctx.newSession`/`withSession` where available and records platform-limited blockers when unavailable.
Dirty pre-commit implementation validation requires exact working_tree_digest plus patch/worktree handoff evidence; promotion gates require immutable proof.
Daemon/agency stop reasons include exact platform/content/remediation diagnostics for unavailable spawn or unsafe dirty transfer.
Graph nodes/edges expose or preserve trace_refs, gate_refs, git_refs, and ArtifactRef-compatible refs for compiler/gate artifacts.
Automation-readiness and agency scheduling cite exact trace/gate/git blockers from graph state.
Legacy build/validation artifacts remain readable through compatibility normalization; no broad historical artifact migration is required.
Graph/status/task lenses remain compact and generated-parity passes.
non_goals: Do not publish or push remote changes.
Do not run broad autonomous refactor work in this task.
Do not bypass independent fresh validation or task-close/ship-ready gates.
Do not migrate every historical `.codewiki/builds` or `.codewiki/validation` file.
Do not change public gate verdict contract.

delta.desired:
Daemon/runtime has command-context fresh-worker bridge and exact dirty-content proof policy.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Graph and automation-readiness consume canonical trace/gate/git/artifact refs from build/gate artifacts instead of relying mainly on legacy path/name inference.
Refinement: Graph/readiness uses canonical trace/gate/git/artifact refs for daemon-safe scheduling.
delta.current:
Runtime models jobs/runs but agent tools cannot spawn fresh Pi sessions; manual /wiki-resume --new remains fallback.
Refinement: TASK-087 added contracts and compatibility helpers; broader graph/lens migration remains in SPRINT-022.
delta.closure:
Spawn bridge behavior and blockers are covered by tests and implementation validation.
Refinement: Generated graph and readiness lenses expose exact refs and audits/tests pass.
